type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the kind of the transport that the operation came from

integrationRef.description: IntegrationRef is the reference of the Integration that authenticated the external actor. It is only set for the INTEGRATION type.

externalActorID.description: ExternalActorID is the stable identifier of the external actor within the Integration's provider (e.g. a Slack user ID or an Atlassian account ID). It is only set for the INTEGRATION type.

externalEventID.description: ExternalEventID is the identifier of the provider event that carried the operation. It is used to recognize the duplicate deliveries of the same external action.

sessionRef.description: SessionRef is the reference of the Session that performed the operation. It is only set for the API type.

Origin.title: Origin
Origin.description: Origin is where an access Request or a Review came from. It is entirely derived by the Cluster from the authenticated transport of the operation itself and it is never accepted from the callers.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
